source: Lets make 3d game with floating island kingdoms with waterfalls,brigdes and a giant crystal castle and around the island you can find 5 diffrent temples with 5 diffrent bosses you can fight and earn coins to unlock new weapons and when you first start make the player equip a katana and when the equip it make some mobs spawn for them to fight so they can updgrade from a katana. also make it when you have 1,000 coins you can create your own clans to go out on adventures and experience and fight new enemies. also make the map 1,000,000,000,000 blocks big. and when you get enough xp make it so you can level up and unlock new maps and the max level right now is level 5,000.

answers.ask: A trillion blocks is not buildable - do you want one island cluster you can cross in a couple of minutes, or a set of separate maps unlocked as you level?
answers.answer: Use a set of separate maps unlocked as the player levels up; this keeps the huge-world feeling while making progression playable.

answers.ask: Crystal castle plus katana could read as bright anime-fantasy or as solemn high fantasy - which look do you want?
answers.answer: Use a bright anime-fantasy look, with colorful floating islands, glowing crystals, and dramatic waterfalls.

answers.ask: Are the five temples on the main island, or is each one its own floating island reached by bridge?
answers.answer: Make each of the five temples its own floating island reached by bridges from the main crystal-castle island.

--- clarifications from the author ---
- [scale] A trillion blocks is not buildable - do you want one island cluster you can cross in a couple of minutes, or a set of separate maps unlocked as you level? Use a set of separate maps unlocked as the player levels up; this keeps the huge-world feeling while making progression playable.
- [theme] Crystal castle plus katana could read as bright anime-fantasy or as solemn high fantasy - which look do you want? Use a bright anime-fantasy look, with colorful floating islands, glowing crystals, and dramatic waterfalls.
- [shape] Are the five temples on the main island, or is each one its own floating island reached by bridge? Make each of the five temples its own floating island reached by bridges from the main crystal-castle island.
config.genre_evidence: Players fight "5 different bosses" and spawned "mobs," earn coins for "new weapons," gain "xp," "level up," and "unlock new maps," with a stated "max level... 5,000."
config.evidence: "a set of separate maps unlocked as the player levels up" and a main crystal-castle island with combat-focused temple/boss destinations; the prompt also specifies mobs spawning for the player to fight and coin-based weapon progression.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this RPG map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Hub and Dungeons: A safe hub feeding separate instanced combat areas entered from the overworld.

INCLUDE:
- Sanctuary Town: A settlement completely isolated from enemy AI where players restock, repair, and turn in quests.
- Economy Ring: Shop, quest giver, and blacksmith clustered tightly together to cut repetitive travel for grinding players.
- Aggro Bowl: Wide open clearings or monster nests holding hostile spawns, set well back from travel roads so low-level players aren't ambushed in transit.
